name: Home Lifts
title: Home Lifts for Villas, Duplexes & Independent Houses
shortDesc: Compact, quiet home lifts for G+1 to G+4 homes — designed around your shaft, stairwell or open void.
overview: A home lift should feel like part of the architecture, not an add-on. We survey your home, recommend the right drive type (machine-room-less traction, hydraulic or screw-driven) and fit a cabin finish that matches your interiors. Ideal for elderly parents, wheelchair users and multi-level family homes in Delhi NCR.

specifications.Capacity: 250 kg to 1,000 kg (3 to 13 persons). Most homes choose 3–6 persons (250–408 kg)
specifications.Speed: 0.15 m/s to 1.5 m/s depending on drive type and travel
specifications.Drive options: MRL gearless traction, hydraulic, or screw / pit-less systems
specifications.Pit & headroom: Shallow-pit and low-headroom options for existing homes
specifications.Cabin: Glass, stainless steel, wood-laminate or custom finish
specifications.Doors: Automatic telescopic or manual swing doors

features: Automatic rescue device (ARD) — lowers to the nearest floor during a power cut
Overload sensor and door safety curtain
Emergency alarm, intercom and battery-backed cabin light
Soft start / stop with VVVF drive for a smooth, quiet ride
Works in a new shaft, existing stairwell void or a glass/steel structure
benefits: Comfortable access to every floor for elderly family members
Adds lasting value to independent homes and villas
Low running cost on single-phase or three-phase supply
Designed to fit renovation as well as new construction
applications: Homes with elderly or differently-abled family members
warranty: Warranty is provided as per the equipment manufacturer's terms and is written into your quotation before work starts.
maintenance: Annual maintenance (AMC) plans with scheduled preventive visits and breakdown support.

faq.q: Can a lift be added to my existing house?
faq.a: Usually yes. We check the space (stairwell void, courtyard, or an external glass structure), pit depth, headroom and power supply during a site survey and recommend the drive type that fits.

faq.q: What happens during a power cut?
faq.a: Home lifts we recommend include an automatic rescue device that brings the cabin to the nearest floor and opens the doors.

faq.q: How much space does a home lift need?
faq.a: Compact cabins start around 900 mm × 1,000 mm internal size. The exact shaft size depends on capacity, door type and drive, which we confirm after the survey.
